label: 0ad readers=4 warm

parameters.pipeline: reader/chunker thread(s) -> bounded queue of batches (<=512 KiB or 256 chunks) -> fixed worker pool; chunk data is copied once

quiet_gate.accounting: host /proc/stat first 8 counters; idle includes iowait; subtract /proc/self/stat utime+stime+cutime+cstime (all own threads and reaped children); no subprocesses in pipeline; kernel workers remain counted

parameters.verify_path: reads with the boundaries recorded by the build run, no chunking, compares hashes

notes: Functional run; decision rule of the benchmark protocol needs the measurement protocol (quiet machine, physical reference without SHA-NI).

Before each repetition: join all reader/worker threads, release previous run allocations, prepare cache, then require three consecutive 1 s external CPU samples <= limit within 120 s. Recheck cache residency after waiting. busy_percent_before_each_rep is the final external CPU sample; quiet_before_each_rep records actual wait and every sample (system, own, external). Failed probes reset the quiet streak.
